definitions.gloss: together; along with; at the same time
definitions.explanation: Doing something jointly with another person or combining things in the same action or location.

examples.japanese: {一緒|いっしょ}に⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一緒|いっしょ}に⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate lunch together with my friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一緒|いっしょ}に⟦ファイル→ファイル：05280_fairu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧おいて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put the documents in the file together with the receipt.

notes:
One of the most frequently used adverbs in Japanese. {一緒|いっしょ}に can describe people doing things jointly, objects being placed in the same location, or events occurring simultaneously.

The particle ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ is commonly used with {一緒|いっしょ}に to specify the companion: A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一緒|いっしょ}に (together with A).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一緒|いっしょ}に⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go together
- {一緒|いっしょ}に⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat together
- {一緒|いっしょ}に⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live together
- {一緒|いっしょ}に⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work together
- {一緒|いっしょ}に⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧: to play together

USAGE:
In casual speech, {一緒|いっしょ}に is sometimes shortened to just ⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧ (without ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). The expression {一緒|いっしょ}に⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧ (let's go together) is a common way to invite someone along.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {共|とも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: together — more formal and literary
- {連|つ}れ{立|だ}って: together, in company — implies physically going somewhere as a group
- ⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: combined, together — focuses on adding things together rather than companionship
